NEW: Sports reporting is shrinking. But at ProPublica, we’re diving in. 

We won’t cover the games, but we’ll be keeping score — of which powerful people are winning, of who’s being hurt and of which systems can be held accountable.

media.title: Why ProPublica Is Leaning Into Sports Investigations
media.description: Sports is a wealthy, powerful industry. We’ll cover the system instead of the games. We’ll ask who’s responsible for some of its biggest problems and who’s preventing them from being fixed.
